landing.title: Calculation and management of materials and tools
landing.lead: The application determines the required materials, hand and power tools for a given scope of work and keeps track of them afterwards. The calculation uses consumption rates for each technology stage; the result is saved as a request. A request is passed to the crew or received into a company warehouse. Items are moved between warehouses and issued to company members; each member has a list of what was issued to them.

method.title: Calculation method
method.intro: A technology consists of stages. Each stage has rates: for materials — per unit of work volume, for tools — per crew. A crew is the smallest working group; a team consists of one or more crews.

materials.text: n — consumption rate per unit of stage volume, V — stage volume. A stage without a volume yields no materials.

tools.text: n — rate per crew, k — number of crews. The maximum across stages is taken, not the sum: the same tool moves from stage to stage.

rounding.text: Items counted in pieces are rounded up to a whole number, others to hundredths.

unfilled.text: When the quantity depends on site conditions, the rate is zero: the item stays in the request with a mark and is filled in manually.

sizes.text: Rates and warehouse stock are bound to the assembly code — the item and its parameter values. When parameters change, the link breaks instead of moving to another size.

ownership.text: Editing a shared technology or item creates your own copy; the original stays unchanged for other users.

anonymous.text: Calculation and requests are available without signing in. Such a request is kept by a key in the browser and is attached to the account after signing in; otherwise it is deleted 30 days after the last change.

links.text: A request opens by link for any recipient — without signing in and without access to the author's other requests.

roles.text: Warehouses belong to a company. Member roles: owner, management, review, storage. The owner and managers assign to warehouses and issue items; a recipient must be a company member.

mobile.text: The layout is designed for a phone screen; action panels are placed at the bottom of the screen.
